mechanism: Both agents increase photosensitivity risk and can cause irritation to skin and mucous membranes; doxycycline is a known photosensitizing agent and adapalene is a retinoid that increases sun sensitivity and skin irritation.
action: Counsel patients to use strict sun protection (SPF ≥30, protective clothing) and may consider spacing applications or using on alternate days; monitor for excessive skin irritation or phototoxic reactions.
